verdicts.title: Form factors for $B$ to $Kll$ semileptonic decay from three-flavor lattice QCD
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We study the $B \to Kl^+l^-$ semileptonic decay process in three-flavor lattice QCD. We analyze several ensembles generated by the MILC collaboration at different lattice spacings and sea-quark masses. verdicts.title: Rotating lattice
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We present the lattice QCD formulation in rotating frames. We start with the continuum QCD action in rotating frames, and then discretize it on the lattice. For the first test of the formulation, we calculate angular momentum in the quenched Monte Carlo simulation, and confirm that the formulation works successfully.
